{{Quote|There is yet hope in the Seswenna sector, as we understand that the Republic fleet regrouped and broke up the blockade of the Rimma Trade Route, meaning more resources to support the fighting there and for those of us battling here in the Minos Cluster.|Jedi Knight Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref>}}
In [[3680 BBY]], during the second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Great Galactic War]], a '''battle''' occurred between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. This was the second battle in the Seswenna sector that the conflict had seen, and like the first, it was waged with the goal of breaking the Imperial [[Blockade of the Rimma Trade Route|blockade]] of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]&mdash;a [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] that ran through the region and supplied resources to the southern reaches of the Outer Rim. Unlike the [[first battle of the Seswenna sector]], this effort proved to be successful, and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] was able to regroup after their earlier defeat to overcome the forces of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Armada]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were forced off of the Rimma Trade Route, which opened the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|lane]] to usage by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] to resupply their fighting forces on Outer Rim fronts, like the [[Minos Cluster Campaign|contested]] [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].

==Prelude==
{{Main|First battle of the Seswenna sector}}
{{Quote|In the first wave alone, the Sith succeeded in seizing control of several star systems in the Outer Rim, destroying the Republic's shipyards in the Sluis sector, and strangling the popular Rimma Trade Route.|A HoloNet dossier on the Sith Empire|<ref name="Holonet">{{HolonetOld|allegiances|sith-empire|The Sith Empire}}</ref>}}
[[File:Prisonersofwar.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Republic soldiers taken as prisoners of war after the first battle of the Seswenna sector.]]
Early in the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] launched a broad but strategic blitz against [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] interests and holdings in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. After [[Tingel Arm campaign|seizing]] the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] and [[Battle of Korriban|striking]] [[Battle of Sluis Van (Great Galactic War)|against]] tactically important [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]], the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] launched a [[Minos Cluster Campaign|massive invasion]] of the resource-rich [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. The offensive was initially very successful, in part because the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] had positioned itself in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] along the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], effectively [[Blockade of the Rimma Trade Route|blockading]] the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|lane]]. The Imperial [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] held the Seswenna [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="JoMGD" /> throughout [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> successfully strangling Republic supply lines meant to carry reinforcements and materiel to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] defenders on the front lines of the Minos Cluster Campaign.<ref name="JoMGD" />

In [[3680 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] into the war and [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]], the [[Republic Army]] mounted an [[First battle of the Seswenna sector|effort]] to break the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] control of the Seswenna sector. The counterattack was thoroughly unsuccessful and saw hundreds of [[Republic soldier]]s taken as [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] of war by the Imperial victors. News of the defeat troubled the Jedi in the Minos Cluster and further lowered Republic morale. However, [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] leaders remained committed to breaking the Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the Seswenna sector to free up the vital Rimma Trade Route.<ref name="JoMGD" />

==The battle==
Shortly after the first attempt to break the blockade, the Republic's [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval fleet]], which had been scattered during the retreat from the Tingel Arm campaign, regrouped for a new assault against the Imperial Armada in the Seswenna sector. The gathered forces of the fleet moved against the blockade and successfully broke the Empire's hold on the Rimma Trade Route, winning the battle and securing the supply line.<ref name="JoMGD" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Though we may be far from putting the Empire on the defensive, we have been successful in liberating several star systems in the Mid Rim, and Republic forces have even regained a foothold in the Minos Cluster.|Gnost-Dural, in 3665 BBY|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
News of the success was quickly spread to other battlefronts in the Outer Rim, raising morale and encouraging Jedi defenders to continue their fight. In the Minos Cluster, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Gnost-Dural]], who was fighting on the front lines of the [[Battle of Eliad]], was relieved to know that the end of the blockade meant the imminent arrival of reinforcements and supplies. As the war continued to drag on in later years, the Republic's ability to move forces along the Rimma Trade Route allowed for its armed forces and Jedi warriors to regain a foothold in the Minos Cluster, which was maintained until the end of the conflict<ref name="JoMGD" /> in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Mention of the battle was included in the [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|wartime journal]] of Gnost-Dural, which was committed to the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Jedi Archives]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="JoMGD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The second battle of the Seswenna sector was first referenced in [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']], a [[2011]] [[List of books|book]] written by [[Robert Chestney]] under the in-universe persona of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Gnost-Dural. The book was included as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' collector's edition game bundle and served as a source of background lore to the massively-multiplayer online [[Star Wars video games|video game]].<ref name="JoMGD" />
